statement: For every actual odd K4,r9 dyadic member there exists a finite rank p with gamma_p>=0. Starting after the exact j=1,3,5 base, follow the audited stable recurrence while its surplus is negative. If the next B-tail stays below its canonical wall, continue. At its first wall B_m>=t=q-(5m-16), the identities gamma_(m-1)=B_m-A_m-A_(m-1)-1-4q<0 and B_m>=30A_m imply A_m+1<q/6; previous stability implies t>q/2. Monotonicity of the rank-m Macaulay raise bounds every carry depth below by the minimum wall B_m=t, hence gamma_m>=C(t,2)-C(A_m+1,2)+2-4q>q^2/9-15q/4+2>0. Since B_m is unbounded, a negative stable orbit must meet a wall in finite time. Together with round four, every member recovers but the recovery ranks have no uniform finite upper bound.
closes: all-j adaptive recovery on the actual K4,r9 family
carry-independent first-wall positivity after a negative stable predecessor
dependency_gaps: extension from K4,r9 to every required adjacent orbit
